title: Universe transport for Zariski restriction
statement: For every sheaf G of Type (u+1) on X, the ULift/order-isomorphism transport identifies the spectral closed restriction bijection with the Zariski inverse-image unit at the top open, yielding a bijection.

proof.text: Assemble the scheme topology instances and transport them along Homeomorph.ulift to make Y = ULift X spectral. Let D be the inverse image of the closed image of i; continuity proves closedness. The homeomorphism preserves preimages of closures and connected sets, proving the required connected point-closure intersections on Y.

Apply the embedding/homeomorphism transport-square theorem to obtain F and equivalences a,b with b composed with the original restriction equal to spectral restriction composed with a. Apply spectral_closed_restriction to Y,D,F. For injectivity cancel a and use injectivity of spectral restriction. For surjectivity lift b(t) through spectral restriction, take its preimage under a, and cancel b using the commuting square.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof using the original ULift/spectral restriction route and an explicit commuting-square comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem zariski_restriction_universe_transport
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hconn : ∀ x : X, IsConnected (closure ({x} : Set X) ∩ Set.range i)) :
      letI : ∀ P : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1),
          (Opens.map (i.base : Z.toTopCat ⟶ X.toTopCat)).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension P :=
            fun P U ↦
              @Types.hasColimit.{u, u + 1, u}
                (CostructuredArrow.{u, u, u, u} (Opens.map i.base).op U)
                inferInstance (small_succ.{u} _) (CostructuredArrow.proj _ U ⋙ P)
      ∀ G : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (u + 1)) X.toTopCat,
      Function.Bijective
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (Opens.map (i.base : Z.toTopCat ⟶ X.toTopCat)) (Type (u + 1))
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z)).unit.app G).hom.app
            (op (⊤ : X.Opens)))
